headline: State Bank of Pakistan Launches Fintech Framework with Mojaloop
summary: The State Bank of Pakistan introduced a new fintech framework using the Mojaloop program to advance financial inclusion and responsible innovation.
why: Regulatory initiatives in digital payments aim to expand banking access and modernize financial infrastructure in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Financial inclusion initiatives improve long-term economic participation.
